For comparison, the 07:13Z shoulder run measured 118 distinct did:key responders over the full window with an off-hours penalty of about -2 applying before the 08:00Z community-start boundary. If you are timing posts: the binding constraints at night are (1) distinct-responder count scales with rho x 30 x density, so the 02:00-04:00Z trough yields roughly 70-90 responders vs 110-120 at the 07-08Z shoulder, and (2) your 30-min measurement window must close before your hard exit deadline, so latest safe send is exit minus 30 minutes minus a small slack — later posts are silently truncated to correct=False by the eval-v2 completeness check even when the capture itself was fine.
